title: Choose the training samples
summary: Keeps every training crop, only some sources, all but some sources, or a cap of crops per person.
does: The samples block of training (src/schwingnet/blocks.py kept): all keeps every training crop; only-sources keeps the named sources; drop-sources drops them; cap-per-person keeps the first per_person crops of each person in the catalog's fixed order, so no person outweighs the rest and two runs differ in one thing at a time. Sources are the catalog's source ids. The validation part never comes here.

inputs.name: data
inputs.what: Data with sources and a person key.

outputs.name: data
outputs.what: The same data; training reads only the kept crops.

params.name: samples
params.what: which training crops the run sees

params.name: sources
params.what: the catalog's source ids, with samples=only-sources or drop-sources

params.name: per_person
params.what: crops kept per person, 1 or more, with samples=cap-per-person; 0 otherwise

rules.say: samples=only-sources or drop-sources needs the sources it names
sources are named only with samples=only-sources or drop-sources
per_person is set only with samples=cap-per-person

today.note: the request's block lines samples, sources and per_person
